title: Two-layer expert-FSDP + expert parallelism
topology: Dense FSDP=8 · EP=4 · Expert FSDP=2 · NVLink
scope: Complete forward + loss + backward; optimizer excluded

verification.label: Measured, FQN-labeled, and Perfetto-audited on 8× H100
verification.implementation: TorchTitan v0.2.0 FSDP2 with an explicit dependency-ordered prefetch graph
verification.workload: Batch 1 × 4096 tokens per rank; BF16; 2 layers; hidden 4096; 128 experts; top-8; expert hidden 1536; deterministic balanced round-robin expert assignment.
verification.measurement: 69.189 ms end-to-end; 68.372 ms rank-0 collective window. Clean timing, FQN-labeled Nsight, and expanded-label Perfetto captures were recorded separately from the same frozen script.
verification.timeline: Actual rank-0 GPU offsets and kernel durations from the clean capture. FSDP module assignments are direct runtime-to-FQN correlations from the labeled capture.

description: This challenge shows the complete captured scope: token embedding, two Qwen3 MoE layers, final norm, output projection, cross-entropy, and backward through the embedding. The optimizer step is deliberately outside this benchmark and is not implied by the timeline.

The prefetch graph is explicit and dependency-ordered. Forward queues L0 dense → L0 experts → L1 dense → L1 experts. Backward queues L1 dense → L1 experts → L0 dense → L0 experts. A labeled Perfetto trace and a separate FQN-labeled Nsight capture verify this order.

The local attention, routing, layout, and gradient-pack kernels are fixed context. Place FSDP all-gathers and reduce-scatters together with one forward and one backward EP path, then identify where expert compute waits for both parameter and activation readiness.

Routing uses TorchTitan's debug balanced round-robin assignment so every expert receives the same number of synthetic token copies. This makes expert compute and all-to-all sizes deterministic; it does not model natural router imbalance.

blocks.description: Materialize the sharded token embedding before its lookup.

blocks.description: Embedding completion explicitly prefetches the layer 0 attention and router parameters.

blocks.label: Token embedding lookup
blocks.description: Gather token embeddings while layer 0 parameters are being prefetched. The marker preserves the measured 65 µs duration while keeping this tiny operation visible.

blocks.label: Layer 0 expert-weight all-gather
blocks.description: Materialize layer 0 experts before any layer 1 parameter collective is allowed onto the FSDP stream.

blocks.label: Layer 0 attention forward
blocks.description: Normalization, QKV GEMMs, RoPE, Flash Attention, output GEMM, and residual work overlap L0 expert materialization.

blocks.label: Prefetch layer 1 dense parameters
blocks.description: Starts only after the layer 0 expert all-gather completes.

blocks.label: Prefetch layer 1 expert weights
blocks.description: Prefetch layer 1 experts while layer 0 routes and exchanges tokens.

blocks.label: Layer 0 router and top-k
blocks.description: Compute router logits, softmax, top-8 selection, and expert histograms.

blocks.label: Layer 0 dispatch activation pack
blocks.description: Gather routed token activations into the EP send layout.

blocks.label: Layer 0 expert FSDP parameter copy-out
blocks.description: Split the gathered flat FSDP buffer into gate, up, and down expert weight views before grouped GEMM.

blocks.label: Host/EP control-flow gate before final norm and output AG
blocks.description: No NCCL kernel is queued here. The CPU must finish the L0 forward control path, including EP synchronization points, and enter L1 pre-forward before it launches the final norm/output prefetch. This is launch timing, not a GPU data dependency.

blocks.label: Layer 0 dispatch metadata exchange
blocks.description: Exchange per-destination token counts before the payload all-to-all.

blocks.label: Layer 0 EP dispatch payload all-to-all
blocks.description: Send routed token activations to expert-owner ranks.

blocks.label: Layer 0 post-dispatch permute
blocks.description: Regroup received tokens by local expert and construct grouped-GEMM offsets.

blocks.label: Layer 0 grouped-GEMM SwiGLU forward
blocks.description: Grouped gate and up GEMMs, SiLU and multiply, then grouped down GEMM.

blocks.label: Final norm and output parameter all-gather
blocks.description: Prefetch the shared final-norm/output FSDP state while layer 0 experts execute.

blocks.label: Layer 0 pre-combine unpermute
blocks.description: Undo expert-major layout before returning expert outputs.

blocks.label: Layer 0 EP combine all-to-all
blocks.description: Return expert outputs to token-owner ranks.

blocks.label: Layer 0 token unpermute, routing-weighted combine, and residual
blocks.description: Scatter returned expert outputs to their original token/top-k positions, multiply by routing probabilities, reduce the eight expert contributions per token, and add the residual. This is large because several memory-bound kernels process roughly 256 MiB of routed BF16 activations.

blocks.label: Layer 1 attention forward
blocks.description: Layer 1 begins after its dense and expert prefetches have completed.

blocks.description: Gather routed activations into the EP send layout.

blocks.label: Layer 1 dispatch metadata exchange

blocks.label: Layer 1 EP dispatch payload all-to-all

blocks.description: Three grouped expert GEMMs and SwiGLU activation.

blocks.description: Undo local expert-major ordering before combine.

blocks.description: Complete the captured forward and evaluate cross-entropy.
